*How records are counted:

  1. Account - User is Owner of account
  2. Contact - User is Owner of contact
  3. Lead - isConverted = FALSE and User is Owner
  4. Interaction - Status is not CLOSED and User is Owner
  5. Opportunity - isClosed = FALSE and User is Owner of Opp
  6. Case - Status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Closed','Closed to SAP','Complaint PKI Closed','Sent to QMS') and User is Owner of case
  7. Task - isClosed = FALSE and Assigned to User
  8. Event - EndDateTime >= TODAY and Assigned to User
  9. PKI Queue Member - User_c = UserID and RemoveMember__c = False
